rationale: Read all 14 lease and credential cases plus all action entrypoints. Retain external Storage generation/conflict/ownership behavior and clock-driven token caching. The in-memory HTTP fake enforces the documented storage service protocol rather than reimplementing the lease decision. Action metadata/source contract tests remain separately pending.

cases.title: acquires a lease on an empty object with ifGenerationMatch=0
cases.reason: An empty storage object is claimed through the shipped HTTP adapter with ifGenerationMatch=0, the requested object name and the serialized holder identity.

cases.title: refuses a live lease held by another run and never writes
cases.reason: A foreign unexpired record throws LeaseConflict, reports the real holder and produces no write against the storage boundary.

cases.title: re-enters a live lease this run already holds and extends it
cases.reason: Reentering the same holder extends expiry while preserving acquisition time and compares the observed generation before replacing the object.

cases.title: takes over an expired lease and warns naming the stale holder
cases.reason: An expired foreign record can be replaced only on its observed generation; the warning identifies the actual previous repository, workflow and run.

cases.title: releases with a generation match and leaves the object gone
cases.reason: Actual acquire then release deletes the object through a generation-matched HTTP request, rather than trusting a release callback receipt.

cases.title: refuses to release a lease another run now holds
cases.reason: Releasing a foreign holder refuses deletion and leaves the stored generation intact.

cases.title: fails closed when the bucket answers 5xx
cases.reason: A 503 response at inspection fails acquisition before any write; the fake implements only the external Storage HTTP boundary.

cases.title: fails closed when permission is denied
cases.reason: A permission-denied HTTP response propagates a distinct failed inspection instead of claiming an inaccessible object.

cases.title: treats an unreadable record as held, not free
cases.reason: A malformed real response body fails closed as LeaseUnreadable and leaves the object generation unchanged.

cases.title: reports a 412 during acquisition as a conflict
cases.reason: A 412 at the write boundary is translated into LeaseConflict and a concurrency diagnosis.

cases.title: renewal rewrites only expires_at on the observed generation
cases.reason: Renewing an acquired record repairs its expired expiry while preserving the acquisition time and holder written by the production lease.

cases.title: renewal stops once the object belongs to someone else
cases.reason: Renewal of a foreign holder returns an explicit refusal instead of extending someone else's ownership.

cases.title: the access token source re-mints only after the reuse window
cases.reason: The real token source caches across a clock advance within its reuse window and remints after crossing it; the fake command returns a distinct token for each actual invocation.

cases.title: the access token source rejects an empty gcloud response
cases.reason: An empty command result is rejected by the real token source, rather than cached as a usable credential.
